traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Quillajaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; margins entire or serrate; veins pinnate; leaves evergreen; blades oblong or ovate; stipules present; plants hermaphrodite or polygamous; ovary superior; stems woody; flowers in corymbs; flowers actinomorphic; perianth sepals and petals; fruit follicle; parts of each whorl 5; stamens 10; carpels 5 (-7). Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
